name: DnssecOracle

methods.name: addAnchors
methods.desc:
Upload the initial root trust anchors, as DNSKEY RDATA, all Valid. Once only: after
this the anchor set changes only by RFC 5011 rollover. Box rent comes from the admin's
credits.

methods.name: setAdmin
methods.desc: Hand over the admin role. The zero address renounces it for good.

args.name: signedData

args.name: hint
args.desc: Montgomery hint for RSA keys, empty for ECDSA

args.name: keyIndex
args.desc: Index of the signing key in the RRset

methods.desc: Prove the root DNSKEY RRset, signed by one of its own keys that is a Valid or Missing anchor.

args.name: keyIndex

args.name: parent

methods.desc: Prove a DS RRset, signed by a key in a proper ancestor's cached DNSKEY RRset.

args.name: keyIndex
args.desc: Index of the signing key in `parent`

args.name: parent
args.desc: The signer's DNSKEY RRset, as cached

methods.desc:
Prove a TXT RRset, signed by a key in the cached DNSKEY RRset of its owner or an
ancestor, and store it as the owner's attestation. Replaces the whole stored RDATA set.

methods.name: updateAnchor

args.name: rrset
args.desc: The root DNSKEY RRset, as cached

args.name: keyHash
args.desc: `sha256(alg ‖ pubkey)` of the key: its anchor box key

methods.desc:
Apply the one RFC 5011 event that the cached root DNSKEY RRset implies for one key.
The key is present if the RRset holds it without REVOKE:

| State   | Present | Event   | Becomes                                   |
|---------|---------|---------|-------------------------------------------|
| none    | yes     | Add     | AddPend; flags 257 and a usable key only  |
| AddPend | yes     | Promote | Valid, 30 days after Add                  |
| AddPend | no      | Reset   | box deleted                               |
| Valid   | no      | Miss    | Missing, still trusted                    |
| Missing | yes     | Return  | Valid                                     |
| Revoked | either  | Retire  | box deleted, 30 days after Revoke         |

Anything else fails with ROL. A new box is paid from the sender's credits, a deleted
one refunded to them.

methods.name: revokeRoot

args.name: keyIndex
args.desc: Index of the revoked, signing key in the RRset

methods.desc:
RFC 5011 revocation: the root DNSKEY RRset, signed by an anchor key in any state but
Revoked, which the RRset holds with flags 385. Only the key itself can revoke itself,
and for good: it can no longer prove the root, and `updateAnchor` retires it 30 days
later. Revoking a Valid or Missing key bumps `rootEpoch`, so everything proven before must
be proven again; an AddPend key never proved anything, so its revocation does not. No
inception rule: a replayed revocation changes nothing.

methods.name: prune
methods.desc:
Delete an expired or stale box. `rrtype` 16 names an attestation: its payer may prune it
once expired, anyone 30 days after or once stale; the refund goes to the payer. Any other
type names a cache entry, which anyone may prune once expired or stale, for a refund to
their own credits.

methods.name: logAttestations
methods.desc: Log each name's attestation box, in input order; an empty line if there is none or it is stale.

methods.name: increaseBudget

args.name: itxns
args.desc: Number of no-op itxns to perform

methods.desc: Buy 700 opcodes per inner call with `itxns` no-op inner app calls.

methods.name: depositCredits

args.name: creditor
args.desc: Account to credit (need not be the sender)

args.name: txn
args.desc: Payment to the contract; its amount is the credit received

methods.desc:
Deposit MBR credits for an account. The payment amount becomes the credit; opening
the creditor's credit box is paid out of the deposit itself, so a first deposit nets
amount minus the box MBR — whoever sends it.

methods.name: logCredits
methods.desc:
Log each account's credit balance (a big-endian uint64) in input order — an empty
log line means the account has no credit box (unambiguous: an existing box logs 8
bytes even at zero balance). Readonly; meant to be simulated with allowMoreLogging
to batch-fetch many balances in one call.

methods.name: withdrawCredits
methods.desc:
Withdraw all remaining MBR credits for the sender. Deletes the credit box, so the
MBR locked for the box itself is refunded too. The inner payment carries zero fee —
callers must cover it with fee pooling (1000 µA extra fee).

desc:
Proves that a TXT RRset exists at a DNS name by verifying the DNSSEC chain from the root
down, one signature per call. Root, DS and DNSKEY RRsets are cached as hashes and shared
by every name below them; TXT RRsets are stored as attestations. Root anchors roll over
by RFC 5011: `updateAnchor` and `revokeRoot`.

No update or delete: the code is fixed once created.

anchorCount.desc: Initial anchors uploaded: 0 until `addAnchors`, which runs once.

rollInception.desc: Inception of the newest root DNSKEY RRset a rollover step used: no step may use an older one.

rootEpoch.desc:
Revocations so far. Each one stales every cache entry and attestation proven before it:
the revoked key may have signed a forged root RRset that they chain from.

anchors.desc: `a ‖ sha256(alg ‖ pubkey)`: root trust anchors and rollover candidates.

caches.desc: `r ‖ sha256(name ‖ type)`: proven root DNSKEY, DS and DNSKEY RRsets.

attestations.desc: `t ‖ sha256(name)`: header, then `uint16 rdlen ‖ rdata` per TXT RR. See reader.algo.ts.
